analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for two consecutive trading days. RSI remains at 61.8 in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram continues to worsen at -11.2781. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.34x the 5-day average. The current price ($2,701.2) is above SMA5 ($2,689.16) and EMA10 ($2,681.86), but the gap with SMA20 ($2,646.68) and EMA20 ($2,642.37) is not significant enough to confirm a trend reversal. The price is likely to continue consolidating between the swing support ($2,626.87) and resistance ($2,720.27).
